name: Trödelmarkt am ROLLER Köln-Marsdorf
facts: long rows laid out in a loop
right next to the Köln-West motorway junction
good parking, including at Globus and Trösser Marsdorf
notes: Only one date in the window, Sat 3 Oct (a public holiday; listed by the organiser); no later 2026 or 2027 dates published. 'Eintritt frei' is from the site-wide Melan header, hence fee 0. Organiser writes 'S-Bahn: 7' for public transport; recorded as 'line 7'. Coordinates from Nominatim for Max-Planck-Straße 5 (the ROLLER store).

description.de: Ein Trödelmarkt auf dem Gelände des ROLLER in Marsdorf, direkt am Autobahnkreuz Köln-West, von 11 bis 18 Uhr. Die langen Reihen laufen im Kreis und sind bei privaten Trödlern beliebt. Parkplätze gibt es reichlich, der Eintritt ist frei.
description.en: A second-hand market on the ROLLER grounds in Marsdorf, right by the Köln-West motorway junction, open 11 to 6. Its long rows run in a loop and are popular with private sellers. Parking is plentiful and entry is free.
